mentions.name: LocalLane
mentions.description: This site helps people start a small business, guiding them through getting a loan, choosing what neighborhood to build in, and figuring out required local permits, with a focus on locally-based small businesses.
mentions.problem: There is a ton of content for people wanting to start a VC-funded business but not enough for small businesses local to your area.
mentions.audience: This targets people wanting to start a small business local to their area, especially those underserved by startup content aimed at VC-funded ventures.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building a site to help someone start a small business. Think figuring out how to get a loan, what neighborhood I should build in, what permits I need, etc. I feel there is a ton of content for people wanting to start a VC funded business but not enough for small business local to your area.
